docs.ug.browsingText: Use the search bar or category chips to find games. Click a card to see details and press Play.
docs.ug.playingText: Games run in the browser. Press Start Game to load the iframe and enjoy.
docs.ug.accountText: Create an account to save scores, submit to leaderboards and report games.
docs.ug.developerText: Register as a developer to publish HTML5/WebGL games on GameHub. Then use the developer portal to manage games, builds and earnings.
docs.ug.developerPortalText: Open /developer after signing in. The sidebar brings together Dashboard, My Games, Earnings and Profile so publishing tasks stay in one place.
docs.ug.gamesText: In /developer/games, create games, edit metadata and open Builds to upload new versions. Use Submit for review only after an approved build is available.
docs.ug.earningsText: In /developer/earnings, review estimated gross revenue, developer share, commercial and rewarded breaks, plus daily detail for each game.
docs.ug.buildsText: Upload a ZIP containing index.html and the game assets. Review validation warnings, approve the build and then submit the game for team review.
docs.ug.publishingWorkflowText: The workflow is upload, validation, Preview, Inspector, build approval, review submission, feedback, and publication. Preview opens a temporary build and never publishes the game; Inspector is for diagnostics. Invalid builds cannot be submitted.
docs.ug.sdkChatText: The SDK chat uses the authenticated EAF ChatHub for realtime events and a GameHub authorization endpoint for sends. Match messages require active participation; sender identity comes from the session, messages are limited to 500 characters, and repeated clientMessageId values are acknowledged without sending twice during the cache window.
docs.ug.reportText: On the game detail page, click Report game and choose a reason. Our team will review it.
docs.ug.securityText: Never put tokens, API keys, or connection strings in a game ZIP. Declare external domains and analytics when requested, and do not collect personal data without a lawful basis and applicable consent.
docs.ug.supportText: For upload, Preview, Inspector, or publishing problems, include the game, build, UTC time, and error message; never send credentials or tokens.
docs.api.authText: Most endpoints require a Bearer token obtained from TokenAuth/Authenticate.
docs.api.catalogText: Public catalog endpoints list published games, categories and search results.
docs.api.gameplayText: Use these endpoints to start a play session, send gameplay events and submit scores.
docs.ag.loginText: Access /admin with an Admin role user.
docs.ag.dashboardText: View daily plays, top games and recent uploads.
docs.ag.moderationText: Review pending games, validate builds and approve, reject or request changes.
docs.ag.categoriesText: Manage taxonomy for the public catalog. Slugs are auto-generated from names.
docs.ag.usersText: List and manage player and developer accounts.
docs.sdk.eventsText: Call these methods when the game reaches relevant lifecycle moments.
docs.sdk.adsText: Request commercial or rewarded breaks. The parent decides if they are shown.
docs.sdk.capabilitiesText: Call getCapabilities before enabling presence, notifications, or invites. Disabled features return false and must not break older games. The current protocol is versioned and chat uses an authenticated context.
